title: F11: Evaluation dataset, runner, comparisons, report
milestone: M6 Evaluation
labels: eval, ai
---
## Goal
Measure extraction quality on labelled receipts, compare configurations, and justify the review status with the precision and recall of `needs_review` (decision 0028).

**Depends on:** F05 (branched from the F13 head, for prompt v3)
**Built by:** `backend-dev` (refactor, `eval/` package, tests) + `eval-runner` (model runs); the student labels the ground truth and interprets the results

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 20 cases with ground truth in `data/eval/` (git-ignored); `python -m eval.run_eval check` passes
- [ ] The pipeline's post-extraction step is one public function (`process_extraction`) used by the pipeline and the evaluation; behaviour unchanged
- [ ] Aggregated metrics for 4 configurations and 2 comparisons: prompts v1/v2/v3 on `gemma3:4b`; `gemma3:4b` vs `qwen2.5vl:3b` on v3
- [ ] Metrics: schema validity, merchant/date/total accuracy, item P/R/F1, name-key agreement, out-of-scope rejection, false rejection, injection followed, copied examples, latency p50/p95, error categories
- [ ] `needs_review` precision and recall for 2 statuses (as shipped; extraction flags only) × 2 truths (derived; hand label), with TP/FP/FN/TN
- [ ] A run resumes from the cache; `score` works offline and rewrites only the marker block of `docs/evaluation.md`
- [ ] Committed results go through `domain.redaction` and `scripts/fixture_scan.py` (decision 0017); images, ground truth and cache stay git-ignored
- [ ] Failure discussion and uncertainty section in `docs/evaluation.md`, linking to `docs/wiki/backend/uncertainty.md`
- [ ] `make check` passes, including `eval/` lint and the new import contracts
